description: Quantify ATP6AP2 population constraint against the ClinVar variant interpretation burden, and check whether reported disease alleles appear in gnomAD
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 research-agent", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

# --- allele frequency of the reported pathogenic ATP6AP2 alleles in gnomAD v4 ---
q = """query($s:String!){ gene(gene_symbol:$s, reference_genome: GRCh38){
  variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ variant_id hgvsc hgvsp consequence
    exome{ ac an af } genome{ ac an af } }
}}"""
j = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", headers=H,
                  json={"query": q, "variables": {"s": "ATP6AP2"}}, timeout=120).json()
v = pd.DataFrame(j["data"]["gene"]["variants"])
def tot_ac(row):
    e = row["exome"] or {}; gm = row["genome"] or {}
    return (e.get("ac") or 0) + (gm.get("ac") or 0), (e.get("an") or 0) + (gm.get("an") or 0)
v[["ac","an"]] = v.apply(lambda r: pd.Series(tot_ac(r)), axis=1)
print("gnomAD v4 ATP6AP2 variants returned:", len(v))

targets = ["c.321C>T", "c.345C>T", "c.293T>C", "c.212G>A", "c.185G>A", "c.284C>A", "c.168+6T>A", "c.628G>T"]
hit = v[v.hgvsc.astype(str).str.contains("|".join([t.replace(">", ">") for t in targets]), na=False)]
print("\nReported disease alleles present in gnomAD v4:")
print(hit[["variant_id","hgvsc","hgvsp","consequence","ac","an"]].to_string(index=False) if len(hit) else "  none of the reported pathogenic alleles found in gnomAD v4")

# observed LoF alleles
lof = v[v.consequence.isin(["stop_gained","frameshift_variant","splice_donor_variant","splice_acceptor_variant"])]
print(f"\npLoF variant entries in gnomAD v4 for ATP6AP2: {len(lof)}; total pLoF allele count = {lof.ac.sum()} / AN ~ {int(v.an.median())}")

# --- figure: constraint + ClinVar interpretation burden ---
const = {"pLoF": (1, 23.42), "Missense": (174, 271.33), "Synonymous": (90, 97.12)}
clinvar = {"Uncertain significance": 132, "Likely benign": 85, "Benign": 23,
           "Benign/Likely benign": 5, "Conflicting": 12, "Pathogenic": 5, "Likely pathogenic": 1,
           "No classification": 86}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5))

ax = axes[0]
labels = list(const.keys())
obs = [const[k][0] for k in labels]; exp = [const[k][1] for k in labels]
x = np.arange(len(labels)); w = 0.38
ax.bar(x - w/2, exp, w, label="expected", color="#b0b7c3")
ax.bar(x + w/2, obs, w, label="observed", color="#4c78a8")
for i, k in enumerate(labels):
    ax.text(i, max(obs[i], exp[i]) + 7, f"o/e = {obs[i]/exp[i]:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=9, weight="bold")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
ax.set_ylabel("variant count in gnomAD v4")
ax.set_title("ATP6AP2 is extremely intolerant to loss of function\npLI = 0.9999, LOEUF = 0.203, missense z = 2.52, synonymous z = 0.43")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

ax = axes[1]
order = ["Pathogenic", "Likely pathogenic", "Conflicting", "Uncertain significance",
         "Likely benign", "Benign/Likely benign", "Benign", "No classification"]
cols = ["#b2182b", "#d6604d", "#f4a582", "#f7f0a0", "#92c5de", "#6aa7cf", "#2166ac", "#cccccc"]
vals = [clinvar[k] for k in order]
ax.barh(range(len(order))[::-1], vals, color=cols)
for i, (k, val) in enumerate(zip(order, vals)):
    ax.text(val + 2, len(order) - 1 - i, str(val), va="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels(order, fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("ClinVar single-gene ATP6AP2 variants (n = 349)")
ax.set_title("Only 6 of 349 small ATP6AP2 variants are P/LP;\n132 remain of uncertain significance")
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
